active_continuity: The Son of Heaven used the White Illusion Jiangshi Art given by Jin Taekyung to remain with Zhu Bao after Zhu Bao asked him to live a thousand years as family.
Ma Sanbao is dead; his forces were trapped and defeated.
The Murim Alliance and its allies secretly located and neutralized Moving Formations.
open_questions: What are the consequences of the Son of Heaven using the White Illusion Jiangshi Art?
